quest.title: Ever Deeper
quest.description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, and despite causing a misunderstanding, you also gain knowledge of evil spirits. The two of you proceed deeper, equal parts expectant and cautious.

talks.objective: Look for signs of evil spirits alone

dialogues.speaker: Zhouliang
dialogues.text: Ugh... I'm beat. Finally, I can take a break.

dialogues.speaker: Zhouliang
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder if I took things a little too far... A few people seemed scared out of their minds.

dialogues.speaker: Zhouliang
dialogues.text: Huh? Hey, you shouldn't be here!

dialogues.speaker: Zhouliang
dialogues.text: *sigh* Never mind. I assume you overheard me anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Zhouliang
dialogues.text: I work here pretending to be a ghost, but now's my break time, so I took off my costume. I get all hot and stuffy wearing that thing...

choices.text: So there are no real ghosts here?

response.speaker: Zhouliang
response.text: Of course, how could there be real ghosts here?

response.speaker: Zhouliang
response.text: No one wants to see a real ghost, neither us nor the participants.

response.speaker: Zhouliang
response.text: They just come here for the atmosphere, or should I say, the chance... Everyone wants the chance to feel the thrill of excitement.

response.speaker: Zhouliang
response.text: When people find themselves in a scary situation, they'll say things that they'd never dare to otherwise. That's what the Test of Courage is all about.

response.speaker: Zhouliang
response.text: *sigh* Okay... I should get back to work now. Hope you and... whoever you're here with have a fun time.

choices.text: It's all planned to scare people, right?
